translations.web: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
translations.bsb: Does not the potter have the right to make from the same lump of clay one vessel for special occasions and another for common use?
translations.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
translations.asv: Or hath not the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel unto honor, and another unto dishonor?
